done_summary: No changes were made. The tests are failing because they depend on a variable `_asyncio_reactor_path` that is not defined in the source code. This variable is used in the tests but not provided in the scrapy package. Without this variable, the tests cannot properly set up the asyncio reactor for testing. The implementation of `AsyncCrawlerProcess` and `Crawler.crawl_async()` was not attempted due to the missing dependency and unclear requirements.
